entries.description: Identified that the TT template's GitHub Action is a free placed-and-routed oracle, and ruled that the tapeout pre-registration is written BEFORE the first harden run — including bring-up acceptance nine months before chips exist.

Left N (the tile count) and the tile geometry as BLANKS with a source field, refusing to supply either from memory, and declared the bar UNARMED until they are filled from the specs page. A guessed threshold decides cases it was never shown, and this one is an input to a 70-euro decision.
entries.artifact_link: TAPEOUT_PREREGISTRATION.md — the one constant this file does not have

entries.description: Pre-registered BOTH a bit-exactness bar and a physics-residual gate for bring-up, not one. Either alone has failed in this project before: RTL and golden once agreed for three rounds on a sign-inverted gain, and a physics check once passed on a value quantised to junk.

Declined to pre-register bars for power, on-die area vs estimate, and yield. Those are measurements to take, not thresholds to clear; inventing thresholds with no basis would be the guessed-threshold defect wearing a rigour costume.
